activities.name: PeekBatch
activities.whenToUse: Use to request a batch through the provider's ReadBatch branch; PeekBatch currently delegates there with the same Plan and ItemSignal. PeekDepth and Visibilitytimeout control read count and visibility, and the branch can make an Azure Storage Queue request.
activities.description: Read messages using provider visibility behavior.

properties.description: Extract queue request configuration and warn when absent.
properties.whenToUse: Supply queue request configuration when the AzureStorageQueue provider needs it; the provider warns when absent before dispatch.

properties.description: Choose how many messages to read.
properties.whenToUse: Set how many queue messages to read through delegated ReadBatch. Omission defaults one; current branch validates range 1–32.

properties.description: Preserve conduction context while cloning the queue request.
properties.whenToUse: Retain incoming parent Phase when the queue request clone needs conduction context; not a queue query parameter.

properties.description: Preserve conduction context while cloning the queue request.
properties.whenToUse: Retain incoming parent Plan when the queue request clone needs conduction context; not a queue query parameter.

properties.description: Set the queue read visibility timeout.
properties.whenToUse: Set read visibility timeout for the delegated ReadBatch request. Omission defaults 10 and the branch requires a positive value.

result.description: provider message identity [provider-returned]. When recursively delegates ReadBatch, including its visibility timeout; queue XML parsed to message objects.
provider receipt [provider-returned]. When recursively delegates ReadBatch, including its visibility timeout; queue XML parsed to message objects.

resultNotes: Queue_AzureStorageQueue: Name PeekBatch does not imply nondestructive peek; source calls ReadBatch

activities.name: HandleMessage
activities.whenToUse: Use to decode a queue message from ItemSignal MessageText or Config.MessageText. The provider may resolve a path route, load a session/plan and run conduction; Config.ResultDetail true requests checked stage status only after a supported path route completes.

properties.description: Optional native Boolean. True requires a decoded path route and returns checked session/plan/conduction stage status only after completion; absent/false preserves successful decoded-message result. Unsupported route or invalid type fails before session effects.
properties.whenToUse: Set native Boolean true only for a supported decoded path route with channel ID and reply path when checked session/plan/conduction stage status is needed after completion. Omit or false to keep the successful decoded-message result; invalid type or route fails before session effects.

properties.description: Extract queue request configuration and warn when absent.
properties.whenToUse: Supply queue request configuration when HandleMessage needs Config.MessageText or ResultDetail. The provider reads Config before dispatch and warns when absent.

properties.description: Use configured message text when the item jacket has none.
properties.whenToUse: Supply message text when ItemSignal %.@.MessageText is absent or blank. The provider requires a resulting message text from one of these locations.

result.description: Decoded message object on successful absent/false Config.ResultDetail; the message alone is not completion proof.
Only ResultDetail=true on the path route after checked Session, Plan and Conduction Signals return nonfailed.
Copied normalized path route for correlation, not an effect observation.
True only when returned Session Signal is nonfailed and its unwrapped identity matches channel.
True only when Memory.Generate returns nonfailed and a keyed usable Name/Phases Plan resolves.
True only when Conduction invocation returns a nonfailed Signal; HasResult is not required. Check independent owned marker for actual work.

resultNotes: Queue_AzureStorageQueue: Default decoded message is not completion proof. Opt-in path detail reflects checked child Signals, not persisted domain effect; require an independent owned marker. Mapped failure exposes no Result.

activities.name: ReadBatch
activities.whenToUse: Use to read Azure Storage Queue messages with a requested depth and visibility timeout. The provider constructs a queue read request and parses the XML response; this can change message visibility.

properties.description: Extract queue request configuration and warn when absent.
properties.whenToUse: Supply queue request configuration for ReadBatch; the provider warns when absent before constructing the storage request.

properties.description: Choose how many messages to read.
properties.whenToUse: Set the queue read count. Omission defaults one, and the branch validates a range of 1–32.

properties.description: Preserve conduction context while cloning the queue request.
properties.whenToUse: Retain incoming parent Phase when the cloned queue request needs conduction context.

properties.description: Preserve conduction context while cloning the queue request.
properties.whenToUse: Retain incoming parent Plan when the cloned queue request needs conduction context.

properties.description: Set the queue read visibility timeout.
properties.whenToUse: Set message visibility timeout for the read request. Omission defaults 10; current validation requires a positive value.

result.description: provider message ID [provider-returned]. When positive depth and visibility timeout; REST response XML is QueueMessagesList; valid batch, including zero messages.
provider pop receipt [provider-returned]. When positive depth and visibility timeout; REST response XML is QueueMessagesList; valid batch, including zero messages.
provider payload; can be empty [provider-returned]. When positive depth and visibility timeout; REST response XML is QueueMessagesList; valid batch, including zero messages.

activities.name: WriteItem
activities.whenToUse: Use to enqueue Config.MessageText in Azure Storage Queue. The provider serializes the supplied text/object, sends a storage request and, on a valid response, returns MessageId and PopReceipt.

properties.description: Extract queue request configuration and warn when absent.
properties.whenToUse: Supply queue request configuration for WriteItem; the provider warns when absent before constructing the request.

properties.description: Serialize and enqueue the supplied message text or object.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the message text or object to serialize and enqueue. The branch fails when this resolver has no Result.

properties.description: Preserve conduction context while cloning the queue request.
properties.whenToUse: Retain incoming parent Phase when the cloned write request needs conduction context.

properties.description: Preserve conduction context while cloning the queue request.
properties.whenToUse: Retain incoming parent Plan when the cloned write request needs conduction context.

result.description: created provider ID [provider-returned]. When MessageText present; REST POST returns QueueMessagesList XML; response contains nonempty identity.
provider receipt [provider-returned]. When MessageText present; REST POST returns QueueMessagesList XML; response contains nonempty identity.

activities.name: AckItem
activities.whenToUse: Use to acknowledge/delete a queue message using MessageId and PopReceipt. The provider first reads Config values and falls back to ItemSignal message identity when absent, then sends a delete request.

properties.description: Extract queue request configuration and warn when absent.
properties.whenToUse: Supply queue request configuration for AckItem when using Config.MessageId or Config.PopReceipt; the provider warns when absent.

properties.description: Identify the queue message MessageId for acknowledgement.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the queue MessageId to acknowledge. If absent, the provider looks for ItemSignal %.@.MessageId.

properties.description: Identify the queue message PopReceipt for acknowledgement.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the queue PopReceipt for acknowledgement. If absent, the provider looks for ItemSignal %.@.PopReceipt.

properties.description: Preserve conduction context while cloning the queue request.
properties.whenToUse: Retain incoming parent Phase when the cloned acknowledgement request needs conduction context.

properties.description: Preserve conduction context while cloning the queue request.
properties.whenToUse: Retain incoming parent Plan when the cloned acknowledgement request needs conduction context.

result.description: When MessageId and PopReceipt supplied; DELETE delegate succeeds.

resultNotes: Queue_AzureStorageQueue: True is a successful request receipt; later absence needs separate visibility-aware observation

activities.name: DeferItem
activities.whenToUse: Reserved unfinished activity. The provider reads intended Visibilitytimeout and checks message identity, but its update-visibility call is commented out and it returns an unresolved signal; do not choose it to defer a message.
activities.description: Defer an item; the current provider branch is unfinished.

properties.description: Extract queue request configuration and warn when absent.
properties.whenToUse: The provider reads queue Config before the unfinished DeferItem branch, but no working defer request is implemented.

properties.description: Read the intended defer visibility timeout in the unfinished branch.
properties.whenToUse: Supply an intended defer visibility timeout only when inspecting the unfinished branch. It defaults 30, but current code does not call the update-visibility API.

resultNotes: No stable public Result field is available for this activity; inspect the Signal/effect at its actual boundary.
Queue_AzureStorageQueue: reserved — No provider UpdateVisibility invocation is implemented
